title: steph bench v3 case
description: One line of bench/matrix/v3/cases/<split>/<family>.jsonl. A case is one distinct command output (task summary) or one session history with a question (task qa). Every case is evaluated twice, with the French and the English production prompt. Fact patterns are Python regexes matched against the answer after bench/matrix/score.py plain(): lowercase, accents removed, typographic apostrophe replaced by '.

id.description: v3-<family>-<nnnn>, stable forever, never reused after a case is dropped.

split.description: dev (40 %): may be read and tuned on. test (60 %): hidden, never shown to a model or an agent that trains, labels or composes a corpus; only the judge harness reads it.

family.description: Taxonomy of DESIGN.md section 2. history-qa is used only with task qa.

subfamily.description: Main binary and subcommand, e.g. git-rebase, pytest, docker-compose-up, apt-list. For qa: the question type (last-error, value-lookup, count, success-check, cross-command, absent).

distro.description: Generic distribution family and major version, e.g. debian-12, fedora-42, macos-26. Never a hostname.

output_lang.description: Language of the terminal output itself (locale of the tool), independent of the prompt language. none: numbers or symbols only.

origin.description: real: captured read-only on a test machine, then anonymized. reconstructed: rebuilt from a public documented output whose licence allows it; source.reference and source.licence are then required.

machine.description: Capture machine class, never a hostname. public for reconstructed cases.

reference.description: Public page the reconstructed output comes from.

licence.description: SPDX id or licence name of the reconstructed source, e.g. CC-BY-4.0.

cmd.description: Command line as typed, anonymized (task summary).

exit.description: Exit code; null when unknown (reconstructed output without documented code).

status.description: success: exit 0. failure: non-zero exit. interrupted: 130 or 143, or killed by the capture timeout.

error_type.description: Main failure class of the output; none for a clean success, warning-only for a success with warnings.

output_raw.description: Raw output, stdout and stderr interleaved as the terminal showed them, ANSI stripped, anonymized (clean_pii.py then audit_pii.py at 0).

history.description: Session, oldest first (task qa). Each entry is a real or reconstructed command in the same format as a summary case.

case_ref.description: Summary case this entry reuses, if any; it must be in the same split.

question.description: The question, as a user would say it, in both prompt languages (task qa).

answer_in_history.description: task qa: false when the right answer is that the history does not contain it.

difficulty.description: easy: one fact on an obvious line. medium: 2 to 3 facts among noise. hard: decisive line buried or clipped by digest, competing numbers, localized output, or a tempting value to invent.

length_class.description: By output_raw lines: short <= 10, medium 11 to 60, long > 60 (qa: total history lines).

input.description: Production B3 input, generated by code from src/steph, never written by hand.

steph_commit.description: Commit of src/steph used for digest() and the prompts.

max_chars.description: digest() cap of the production format B3 (about 200 Granite tokens).

qa_block_chars.description: task qa: per-command history block cap (production 2500).

qa_budget_chars.description: task qa: total history cap (finetuned profile 8000).

facts.description: Rule of DESIGN.md section 5. Each fact exists in French and English; numbers and names are identical in both.

need.description: What a good answer must say. Every literal it requires must be present in input.fr and input.en (checked by tools/validate.py).

never.description: Case-specific content a good answer must not say: invented values, confusions (loopback, total instead of free, wrong file). Global never patterns live in scoring.json.

reference.description: Reference spoken answers; each must score 100 % against facts and respect max_words.

max_words.description: 20 for summary, 30 for qa (facts.v2.json _max_words). Longer answers are multiplied by 0.8.

author.description: Role of the author, e.g. lot-agent-L05. Never a person's name.

contested.description: true when the two readers disagree: reported apart, never decisive alone.

manual_sample.description: true if the case was in the hand-read sample of its lot.

leak_check.description: Fingerprint comparison with the training corpora, run in place on the corpus hosts (DESIGN.md section 7).

cwd.description: task qa: current directory of the session, sent before the question as in server._ask.

canary.const: STEPH BENCH V3 - NEVER TRAIN ON THIS. steph-bench-v3-canary-6e21d5e02bf0
canary.description: Any document containing it is filtered out of training corpora.

messages.description: [system, user] for a summary; [system, history, acknowledgement, question] for a question, exactly as steph sends them to a fine-tuned model.

id.description: Short fact name, e.g. failing_test, free_gb, file_line.

desc.description: What the fact is, in French, for the reviewers.

fr.description: Regex alternatives accepted in a French answer (synonyms included). The fact is met if any matches.

en.description: Regex alternatives accepted in an English answer.
